_what: The mutants expected to SURVIVE today, each a documented blind spot with the test that will one day kill it. `scripts/mutants.py --check-baseline` stays green while the survivor set is a subset of this list; a mutant that WAS being killed and now survives is a real regression (a guard lost its teeth) and goes red. A mutant listed here that gets killed is good news — tighten this file in the same commit that added the test.
_how_to_remeasure: python3 scripts/mutants.py   (full run, ~25 min; --quick for a weaker fast look)

expected_survivors.01-qt-meta-latch-never-rearms: no lifecycle test yet — killed when the metadata engine moves out of main.qml and under qmltestrunner (plan stage 4)
expected_survivors.02-icy-inflight-never-cleared: needs a two-title-query behavioural test, which wants the same metadata engine extraction first
expected_survivors.07-sink-mute-absolute: the volume path's absolute-0 unmute has no invariant; its neighbour toggleSinkMasterMute does, so a text guard cannot tell them apart
